licences.wims_title: The exercises and the OEF format
licences.wims_body: The exercises come from the WIMS project and its community of authors, under the GNU GPL. PAX replays their format (OEF, DEF) and ports their marking logic; it does not replace them. Each exercise keeps its author, named in the module it comes from.
licences.deps_body: The components below make the site work. Some run on the server, others in your browser.

manifeste.title: Manifesto
manifeste.lead: Why this project exists, and what it owes to WIMS.
manifeste.pourquoi_body:
Practice needs repetition, and repetition needs questions that change. That is what WIMS has done for thirty years: parameterised exercises, drawn at random, marked automatically, written by teachers for their students.

PAX takes up that principle with today's tools, and asks nothing of anyone: no account needed to practise, no tracker, no reliance on a third-party service.
manifeste.choix_body:
Stay compatible. The thousands of exercises written for WIMS run here without being rewritten — that is the condition for their authors' work to keep serving.

Stay readable. The code explains why it does what it does, above all where it reproduces a WIMS quirk: faithful marking beats elegant marking that gets the answer wrong.

Stay free. Under the AGPL, including for whoever hosts the service.
manifeste.ouvert_body: PAX is a work in progress. Not every exercise type is ported, and some only partly — the repository keeps that count up to date rather than hiding it.
manifeste.merci_body:
To the WIMS team and its authors, who built and maintained a free exercise library for three decades, and documented it well enough that a faithful clone could be written.

PAX is not affiliated with the WIMS project. It is an attentive reader of it.

cgu.objet_body: PAX provides interactive exercises in mathematics and science. Questions are drawn at random on each attempt and marked automatically. The service is provided as is, for teaching purposes.
cgu.acces_body: Exercises can be used without an account. Access may be suspended at any time, in particular for maintenance, without notice or compensation.
cgu.compte_body: An account is required to follow or set homework. Accounts are opened by a teacher or an administrator; there is no open sign-up. You are responsible for keeping your password confidential and for what is done from your account.
cgu.donnees_body:
Accounts hold a first name, a surname, an email address and a role. Exercise attempts and marks are kept so that progress can be followed.

No data is passed to third parties and the site uses no advertising tracker. You have a right of access, rectification and erasure, to be exercised with the contact given above.

cgu.contenus_body: The exercises come from the WIMS project and its authors. They may contain mistakes, and their automatic marking may be wrong. They are neither a test nor an official assessment.
